paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Matya: Eduyot, chapter 2, mishnah 5 (106 and 112); Ketubbot 6. Three things were said before Rabbi Yishmael, and he pronounced neither prohibition nor permission; Rabbi Yehoshua ben Matya explained them. If so, he lived at the time they appointed Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah. His brothers were R.A. [ר״א] and Rabbi Yochanan, in the chapter HaSokher.
